mapper.select: SELECT oi.goods_id AS goodsId, oi.goods_name AS goodsName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS amount FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) GROUP BY oi.goods_id, oi.goods_name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT #{top}

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS amount FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN goods g ON oi.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN category c ON g.category_id = c.id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) GROUP BY c.id, c.name
